about: EAAA India Alternatives Limited is one of the leading alternatives asset management platforms in India with over 17 years of experience. The company manages long-term capital across two primary verticals: Real Assets (infrastructure and commercial real estate) and Private Credit (performing credit, special situations, and real estate credit). As of June 30, 2026, it had an AUM of ₹95,344.88 crore and fee-paying AUM (FPAUM) of ₹48,623.18 crore across onshore and offshore institutional and private wealth clients.

peers.name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Limited

objects.purpose: Offer for Sale by Promoter Selling Shareholder

concentration.note: Foreign clients accounted for ₹32,228.52 crore or 33.80% of total AUM as of June 30, 2026. Repeat clients contributed 77% of total commitments across funds as of June 30, 2026.

litigation_note: As of June 30, 2026, contingent liabilities totaled ₹37.70 crore, comprising disputed income tax demands of ₹37.48 crore and civil litigation pending against the holding company of ₹0.23 crore.
strengths: Leading Indian alternatives asset management platform with over 17 years of operating experience.
Substantial scale with AUM of ₹95,344.88 crore and fee-paying AUM of ₹48,623.18 crore as of June 30, 2026.
Diversified multi-strategy offerings spanning high-growth Real Assets and Private Credit markets.
Strong capital raising and deployment track record, having raised ₹47,526.25 crore across FY24-FY26 and Q1 FY27.
High client loyalty with repeat clients contributing 77% of commitments as of June 30, 2026.
Dedicated operational asset management capabilities through wholly owned subsidiary Sekura India Management.
Comprehensive institutional-grade risk management framework and ESG compliance standards.

risks.title: Variable Additional Return Volatility
risks.detail: Variable Additional Return accounted for 30.14%, 24.25%, and 16.19% of Total Income in FY26, FY25, and FY24; its timing and receipt are unpredictable and volatile.

risks.title: Historical Negative Operating Cash Flows
risks.detail: The company reported negative cash flows from operations of ₹120.17 crore in FY25 and ₹13.27 crore in FY24 due to GP fund commitments and distributor payouts.

risks.title: Regulatory Actions on Promoters and Group Entities
risks.detail: Promoter and Group companies face regulatory oversight; in May 2024, RBI issued a cease-and-desist order on ECL Finance Limited regarding structured wholesale exposures.

risks.title: Exposure to Foreign Client Commitments
risks.detail: Foreign clients contributed ₹32,228.52 crore or 33.80% of total AUM as of June 30, 2026, creating exposure to global regulatory shifts and currency volatility.

risks.title: Large Interim Dividend Outflow
risks.detail: In Fiscal 2026, the company declared and paid a significant interim dividend of ₹32.00 per share aggregating ₹205.70 crore, impacting cash reserves.

risks.title: Indebtedness and Financing Covenants
risks.detail: Consolidated borrowings stood at ₹441.03 crore as of March 31, 2026 and ₹399.20 crore as of June 30, 2026, exposing the business to covenant and interest rate risks.

risks.title: Entire Offer is an Offer for Sale
risks.detail: The public offer consists entirely of an OFS of up to ₹1,200 crore by the Promoter Selling Shareholder; the company receives no proceeds.

risks.title: Contingent Liabilities and Tax Demands
risks.detail: The company has contingent liabilities of ₹37.70 crore as of June 30, 2026, including ₹37.48 crore in disputed income tax appellate matters.

notes: Financial figures are consolidated and converted to ₹ crore from ₹ million. Periods Mar-24, Mar-25, and Mar-26 reflect fiscal years ended March 31; stub period for three months ended June 30, 2026 is ignored in period arrays as per instructions.
